ice.definition: A gas or liquid, normally water, which has been frozen (made solid)
ice.sentence: Ice is the solid state of water.

idea.definition: An idea is a concept or a thought.

ideal.definition: If something is ideal, it is as good as you can imagine.
ideal.sentence: You can lose weight safely, and maintain your ideal weight forever.

identify.definition: If you identify something, you say what it is.

identity.definition: Your identity is your name, your personality, and the things that make you different from other people.
identity.sentence: Before I can give you money from your bank account, you have to prove your identity.

ignore.definition: If you ignore someone or something, you don't listen to, look at, or pay attention to them.

ill.definition: Sick, not well. If you are ill, you have bad health, you might have a disease.
ill.sentence: You are making me ill with your attacks.

illegal.definition: An illegal act or object is one that does not follow the law.

illness.definition: An illness is a sickness or a disease.

illustrate.definition: If you illustrate something, you draw a picture of it, or you explain it.

illustration.definition: An illustration describes something in the form of pictures; to illustrate.

image.definition: An image is something you can see or imagine that looks like the real thing.
image.sentence: Many people have an image of God as an old man.

imagination.definition: Imagination is the ability to see something in your mind, or pretend that something false is true.
imagination.sentence: Children use imagination to see sticks as swords and fight monsters.

imagine.definition: If you imagine something, you make a picture of it in your head.
imagine.sentence: Imagine that you're sitting at a table with all the food you can eat.

immediate.definition: If something is immediate, it happens right away, without waiting.
immediate.sentence: They are asking for an immediate withdrawal of American forces from Iraq.

immediately.definition: If you do something immediately, you do it with no time or space between.
immediately.sentence: One car went by, immediately followed by a second at high speed.

immigrant.definition: An immigrant is a person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country.

immigration.definition: Immigration is the movement of people or animals into an area, usually a country.
immigration.sentence: The government wants to tighten immigration controls, but it does not want to be seen as anti-foreign.

implement.definition: If you implement a plan, you put it into action; you do it.
implement.sentence: To reduce poverty, it is essential for the government to fully implement the new education policy.

implementation.definition: Implementation is the process or result of putting a plan into action.
implementation.sentence: The agency was created for the implementation of the policy.

implication.definition: An implication is a result that may be expected or predicted.
implication.sentence: Even if you did not call me a liar, the implication is there.

imply.definition: If you imply something, you mean it, but you don't say it directly.
imply.sentence: What does it imply about him if he uses bad language all the time?

import.definition: When you import something, you are bringing goods from another country to your own country.

importance.definition: The importance of something, is how important it is.
importance.sentence: The importance of a well-balanced diet.

impose.definition: If you impose something on someone, you force it on them, even if they don't want it.
impose.sentence: Could we impose on you to explain that again more slowly?

impossible.definition: If something is impossible it cannot happen or cannot be done.
impossible.sentence: It is impossible for people to breathe water.

impress.definition: If you impress someone, you make them think good things about you.
impress.sentence: To make a batik, you impress a design with wax.

impression.definition: The impression is the effect something has on a person.
impression.sentence: It is always important to make a good first impression.

impressive.definition: If something is impressive, it makes a positive impression or is able to impress someone.

improve.definition: If something improves, it changes from bad to good.
improve.sentence: The government is planning to improve the quality of rail service by adding new trains.

improvement.definition: An improvement makes something better; it improves something.
improvement.sentence: The improvement of this entry was well done.

incentive.definition: An incentive is something that makes you feel like you want to do something.

inch.definition: A unit of length that is equal to 2.54 centimetres; there are 12 inches in a foot.

incident.definition: An incident is an event or occurrence.
incident.sentence: What happened before was sure an unusual incident.

include.definition: When you include something, you make it part of something else.
include.sentence: I include you in the list of culprits.

income.definition: Income is the money that you get from working.
income.sentence: Generally, teachers have a lower income than business people.

incorporate.definition: If x incorporates y, y is part of x.
incorporate.sentence: All the Wilsons ladies' clubs incorporate features designed to help women players improve and enjoy their game.

increasingly.definition: If something is increasingly happening or true, it is more and more so.
increasingly.sentence: Increasingly, people are driving electric cars.

indeed.definition: You use indeed to make your words stronger.
indeed.sentence: OK David, thanks very much indeed for your time.

independence.definition: If you have independence, you are alone or relying on yourself.
independence.sentence: The American soldiers bravely fought against the British to earn their independence.

independent.definition: If something or someone is independent, they are free; they are not dependent on anything.

index.definition: An index is an alphabetical (A to Z) list, usually at the back of a book, where you can find the pages in a book that talk about particular things or words.
index.sentence: Look in the index to see where they talk about Chomsky.

indicate.definition: If someone indicates something, they point it out or they point to it; they bring your attention to something.
indicate.sentence: Dark clouds indicate rain is coming.

indication.definition: An indication is something that points out or indicates something else.
indication.sentence: The market changes were an early indication of the recession.

individual.definition: An individual person or thing is looked at separately from others.
individual.sentence: This office assists whole families rather than individual family members.

industrial.definition: If something is industrial, it has something to do with industry.

industry.definition: An industry is a kind of work that makes things.
industry.sentence: Many people in this country have jobs in the clothing industry.

infant.definition: An infant is a newborn or a baby; a young child in the first stage of their life.

infection.definition: An infection is when germs enter the body and make it sick.
infection.sentence: He had a serious infection from the cut on his arm.

inflation.definition: Inflation is a general increase in the price of goods and services.
inflation.sentence: Because of inflation, I can't afford to go to the movies anymore.

influence.definition: An influence is a force that causes something to happen or for someone to do something.
influence.sentence: Aerosmith has been quite an influence on rock music.

inform.definition: If you inform someone of something, you give them knowledge about it.
inform.sentence: Unfortunately, they did not fully inform the public of the problem.

information.definition: Information is facts, details, numbers, names, and other forms of knowledge.
information.sentence: The nurse can provide you with more information about healthy eating.

initial.definition: The initial period, stages, etc. come near the beginning.
initial.sentence: They send most workers to the US after an initial training period of three months.

initially.definition: If something happens initially, it happens at the start of it.

initiative.definition: If you have or take the initiative, you are in control and can decide what to do next.
initiative.sentence: It's good to see someone take the initiative and start doing something about this problem.

injure.definition: Injure means to hurt someone or an animal; causing harm to a person or an animal.

injury.definition: An injury is when someone or an animal is hurt; when something has caused a person or an animal to be harmed.
injury.sentence: Our client is suing for injury arising from breach of contract.

inner.definition: An inner item is located close to the center.
inner.sentence: The inner city was crowded and dirty.

innocent.definition: If you are innocent you do not know evil.
innocent.sentence: How could he hurt an innocent child?!?

innovation.definition: Innovation is the process of making something new and original.
innovation.sentence: Our company has stayed in the lead largely by encouraging innovation.

input.definition: The input is the information that is put into something.
input.sentence: Everyone who is affected should have a chance to provide input.

inquiry.definition: An inquiry is a request for information.

inside.definition: The inside of something is the part that you can't see or can't touch because other parts are around it.
inside.sentence: The inside of my mouth hurts.

insight.definition: A very good understanding of something; a clear idea about how something works.
insight.sentence: We need to get some insight into the causes of this problem.

insist.definition: To insist means to get your own way without listening to other people's comments.

inspire.definition: If something inspires you, it gives you ideas, or it makes you want to create.

install.definition: If you install a piece of hardward or software, you connect, set up or prepare it to be used.

instance.definition: An instance of something is a time or situation when it happens.
instance.sentence: In this particular instance, the computer was the problem, not the user.

instead.definition: In place of, or as an alternative to.

institution.definition: A custom or practice of a society or community.
institution.sentence: The institution of marriage is present in many cultures but its details vary widely across them.

institutional.definition: If something is institutional, it is related to or has the characteristic of an institution.

instruction.definition: An instruction is a command or a step that helps you achieve a goal.

instrument.definition: An instrument is any thing people hold in their hand and use to do something.
instrument.sentence: A hammer is a heavy instrument.

insurance.definition: Insurance is an agreement where someone pays a small amount of money, and if something bad happens, they get money to help them.
insurance.sentence: I have fire insurance for my house.

insure.definition: If you insure something, you pay money so that if something bad happens to it, you will get more money.
insure.sentence: We will insure your home against damage caused by fire.

integrate.definition: If you integrate x into y, you combine them together to form one whole.
integrate.sentence: The students at this school integrate immediately, despite their different backgrounds.

intellectual.definition: An intellectual is an intelligent person, or a person who has learned a lot about a subject.
intellectual.sentence: Doctor Smith is an intellectual person in medicine.

intelligence.definition: Intelligence is the ability to think clearly and understand easily.
intelligence.sentence: The school has special classes for student of low intelligence.

intend.definition: If you intend something, you have it in your mind as your plan, goal, wish, etc.
intend.sentence: I fully intend to help, as soon as I got the time.

intense.sentence: The intense heat of the day has gone, and a cooler evening is here.

intention.definition: An intention is a plan to do something.
intention.sentence: I have no intention of getting married until I'm thirty.

interaction.definition: An interaction is when two or more things affect each other or work together.
interaction.sentence: Poor health can harm older people's participation in everyday life and social interaction.

interest.definition: An interest is when a person wants to know more about someone or something or likes someone or something or likes to do something.
interest.sentence: She has a strong interest in art. She is going to go to an art school.

interior.definition: The interior of something is located at the inner part of it.

internal.sentence: Doctors had to operate to stop the internal bleeding.

international.definition: An international event, situation, idea, etc. includes two or more countries.
international.sentence: In soccer news, France beat Japan in international competition.

interpret.definition: If you interpret something, you understand a particular meaning in it, and may explain that meaning to others.
interpret.sentence: Children's behaviour can often be difficult to interpret.

interpretation.definition: An interpretation is an attempt to understand something.
interpretation.sentence: Weather forecasters use a lot of data, but the interpretation of the data is very difficult.

intervention.definition: An intervention is an activity designed to change or stop a situation.
intervention.sentence: The teachers planned a reading intervention for the students who were having trouble.

interview.definition: An interview is when questions are asked formally.
interview.sentence: I was given an interview to see if I was right for the job.

introduce.definition: If you introduce someone or something, you make them known to someone else.
introduce.sentence: Let me introduce you to my friend.

introduction.definition: An introduction is the first or opening part.
introduction.sentence: This is the introduction to the book.

invent.definition: If you invent something, you make or design a new kind of thing.

invest.definition: If you invest your money, you use your money to make more money.
invest.sentence: IBM may invest new money in the company.

investigate.definition: If you investigate a problem, you get information about it and you think carefully about the information, usually to find an answer.
investigate.sentence: Researchers continue to investigate new ways of finding lies.

investigation.definition: An investigation is a careful look at a crime, problem, etc. to find the truth or a solution.
investigation.sentence: The cause of the fire is currently under investigation.

investment.definition: Investment is the use of money, time, or effort to make a profit.
investment.sentence: Often you'll have to wait for years before you can get even part of your investment back.

investor.definition: An investor is someone who gives money to a business or person in order to receive financial returns.

invitation.definition: If you receive an invitation, you are being asked to attend an event.
invitation.sentence: An invitation to a party can be a written one or a verbal one.

invite.definition: If you invite someone to something, you ask them to be there.

involve.definition: If an activity involves something, then that thing is used in or is part of the activity.
involve.sentence: Don't involve me in your family affairs!

involvement.definition: Your involvement in something is the way that you participate or are affected.
involvement.sentence: He escaped involvement in the accident.

iron.definition: An element with the symbol Fe and the atomic number 26.
iron.sentence: An object that has iron in it is attracted to magnets.

island.definition: An island is a piece of ground that is completely surrounded by water.
island.sentence: The fisherman lived alone on a small island in James Bay.

isolate.definition: If you isolate something, you make it so that it does not or cannot contact certain other things.
isolate.sentence: We want to isolate ourselves from everyday worries.

issue.definition: An issue is a particular topic or subject, often one that people are discussing and/or is a problem.
issue.sentence: The students raised an important issue in my last class, and I hope we can discuss it today.

item.definition: An item is a particular thing that is separate from other things.
item.sentence: The first item to discuss at today's meeting is the noise from the new road.
